trained_on: 77,988 NIH ChestX-ray14 films (official train_val minus a 10 % patient-grouped validation split), 224 px, 8 epochs, one Kaggle T4 GPU-hour
evaluated_on: NIH official test split, 25,596 films (25,596 for AUROC/AUPRC; thresholds fitted on a random half, threshold metrics reported on the other 12,798)
notes: Accuracy per finding is dominated by the negatives (prevalence 0.2-18 %); it is reported because it was asked for, but AUROC / AUPRC / F1 are the informative numbers.
Probabilities are uncalibrated (class-weighted training); thresholds are per finding.
